Media Control Client Exported Functions

group MCP_Client_Exported_Functions

Functions

void mcp_client_cfg_cccd(uint16_t conn_handle, uint32_t cfg_flags, bool gmcs, uint8_t srv_instance_id, bool enable)

Configure CCCD.

mcp_client.h

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    mcp_client_cfg_cccd(conn_handle, cfg_flags, gmcs, srv_instance_id, enable);
}

参数:

  • conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle.

  • cfg_flags -- [in] MCP Client Configure CCCD Flag.

  • gmcs -- [in]

    • true : Generic Media Control Service (GMCS).

    • false : Media Control Service (MCS).

  • srv_instance_id -- [in] Service instance id.

  • enable -- [in]

    • true : Enable CCCD.

    • false : Disable CCCD.

bool mcp_client_read_char_value(uint16_t conn_handle, uint8_t srv_instance_id, uint16_t char_uuid, bool gmcs)

Read characteristic value.

If sending operation is successful, the result of read characteristic value will be returned by callback registered by ble_audio_cback_register with msg LE_AUDIO_MSG_MCP_CLIENT_READ_RESULT and buf T_MCP_CLIENT_READ_RESULT.

mcp_client.h

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    bool retval = mcp_client_read_char_value(conn_handle, srv_instance_id, char_uuid, gmcs);
}

// Callback registered by @ref ble_audio_cback_register
{
    switch (msg)
    {
    case LE_AUDIO_MSG_MCP_CLIENT_READ_RESULT:
        {
            ......
        }
        break;
    ......
}

参数:

  • conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle.

  • srv_instance_id -- [in] Service instance id.

  • char_uuid -- [in]

    • MCS_UUID_CHAR_MEDIA_PLAYER_NAME

    • MCS_UUID_CHAR_TRACK_TITLE

    • MCS_UUID_CHAR_TRACK_DURATION

    • MCS_UUID_CHAR_TRACK_POSITION

    • MCS_UUID_CHAR_MEDIA_STATE

    • MCS_UUID_CHAR_CONTENT_CONTROL_ID

    • MCS_UUID_CHAR_PLAYING_ORDERS_SUPPORTED

    • MCS_UUID_CHAR_MEDIA_CONTROL_POINT_OPCODES_SUPPORTED

  • gmcs -- [in]

    • true : Generic Media Control Service (GMCS).

    • false : Media Control Service (MCS).

返回值:

  • true -- Sending operation is successful.

  • false -- Sending operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending operation.

bool mcp_client_write_media_cp(uint16_t conn_handle, uint8_t srv_instance_id, bool gmcs, T_MCP_CLIENT_WRITE_MEDIA_CP_PARAM *p_param, bool is_req)

Write Media Control Point characteristic.

If sending operation is successful and Media Control Server sends Media Control Point Notification, Media Control Point Notification will be returned by callback registered by ble_audio_cback_register with msg LE_AUDIO_MSG_MCP_CLIENT_MEDIA_CP_NOTIFY and buf T_MCP_CLIENT_MEDIA_CP_NOTIFY.

mcp_client.h

Example usage 

void test(void)
{
    bool retval = mcp_client_write_media_cp(conn_handle, srv_instance_id, gmcs, p_param, is_req);
}

// If sending operation is successful and Media Control Server sends Media Control Point Notification
// Callback registered by @ref ble_audio_cback_register
{
    switch (msg)
    {
    case LE_AUDIO_MSG_MCP_CLIENT_MEDIA_CP_NOTIFY:
        {
            ......
        }
        break;
    ......
}

参数:

  • conn_handle -- [in] Connection handle.

  • srv_instance_id -- [in] Service instance id.

  • gmcs -- [in]

    • true : Generic Media Control Service (GMCS).

    • false : Media Control Service (MCS).

  • p_param -- [in] Point to media control point parameter: T_MCP_CLIENT_WRITE_MEDIA_CP_PARAM.

  • is_req -- [in]

    • true : Write request.

    • false : Write command.

返回值:

  • true -- Sending operation is successful.

  • false -- Sending operation is failed.

返回:

The result of sending operation.
